_readme: Ship-module engineering blueprints for the Commander view's Engineering list (outrider/commander.py): the materials each grade takes, by the journal's material names, and the engineers offering it. Built by scripts/build_blueprints.py from EDCD's coriolis-data (modifications/blueprints.json, modules.json) and FDevIDs (material.csv); the game data is Frontier Developments'. Experimental effects and Odyssey suit and weapon upgrades are not in it.
